>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Every catalog on this grid - subscribed and created-here alike - with
what each currently provides, where it came from (`role`) and whether
this grid may change it (`write_access`).

A registered catalog whose directory has gone missing is reported with
`present: false` rather than omitted, so the operator can see the
discrepancy instead of it silently vanishing.
